claims.text: 'The MoD eventually closed its UFO desk in 2009, having deemed it surplus to the UK's defence requirements.'

The British UFO programme 'lacked its own formal, catchy name, unlike its equivalent in the United States, Project Blue Book ... because the UK government wanted to play down the true extent of its own interest in investigating UFO sightings'.
Pope joined the MoD in 1985 and 'boarded its UFO programme in 1991', staying at the UFO desk for three years, 'scrutinising UFO reports to identify potential defence risks to the UK'.
Elizabeth Weiss announced on 6 April 2026: 'My heart is breaking. Nick passed away this afternoon at our home.'

edges.label: 2025 Canadian recommendation versus the 2009 British closure
edges.note: Canada in 2025 recommends building the standing public UAP service that Britain abolished in 2009 and that Pope spent the intervening years arguing should not have been abolished. Reasoning: the two governments moved in opposite directions on the same question sixteen years apart.
